title: GS21 leverage hump, gs_bv -1.0, unbounded, per-firm compensation (gs_qcomp 1)
question: Does the leverage hump clear the bar once the exposure is not switched off by the cap?
notes:
WHY (2026-11-05). With gs_qcomp 1 the hump's room stops rising in the loading at about 10% (gvylqc10 10%, gvylqc15 10%, gvylqc20 7%) and swings across seeds from 0 to 37%. The bounded factor h_e(y) = c / (1 + (c-1) e^{-c e y/(c-1)}) saturates once |y| > ~(c-1)/(c|e|), so at e ~ 1 and c = 2 the exposure is off whenever y is more than about half a standard deviation from 0: a larger loading narrows the band where the hump is live, and seeds whose evaluation window sits away from y = 0 see none of it. This economy: UNBOUNDED exposure (e^{e y}); the compensation W(e) keeps the priced value finite. Otherwise gvylqc10.

PRECOMMITMENT STATUS: precommitted=false; ids filled from the Quest build log by the solve script before any seed runs.

PREDICTION (2026-11-05): the premium across lev quintiles is hump-shaped; room 30% or more and a fair gap at or above +0.029. FALSIFIED if room is at or below 10% on three seeds.
